title: The Necessary tool for the job
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：necessary　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 necessary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the father wrote of ① a necessary tool for the job in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② so necessary that nobody in the house would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the necessary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the necessary tool for the job that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too necessary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the necessary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a necessary result of the change, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as necessary as the result of the change they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was necessary or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something necessary, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite necessary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the necessary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, before dawn, she wrote of another necessary tool for the job in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less necessary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The necessary result of the change that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the necessary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 必要（前置定语 a necessary tool for the job：1971 年父亲在家书里记下的那件必要的家什）
B. adj. 必要／必然（两处加强说法：so necessary that … 与 no less necessary than …）
C. adj. 必要／必然（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 必要（表语 too necessary to do：母亲觉得它太必要，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 必然（前置定语 a necessary result of the change：叔叔把整件事称作一桩必然的结果）
F. adj. 必然（同级比较 as necessary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩变革的必然结果相比）
G. adj. 必然（后置定语 something necessary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 必然（受程度副词修饰 quite necessary：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a necessary tool for the job
the necessary tool for the job that
a necessary result of the change
The necessary result of the change that

answers.why: necessary 意为“必要”，1971 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件必要的家什”，此处作前置定语 a necessary tool for the job。
necessary 意为“必要”，此处用 so necessary that 结构，说它必要到老屋里没人敢靠近。
necessary 意为“必要”，家书上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的必要干活必备的家什，等于最高级的说法。
necessary 意为“必要”，母亲认为这件东西“太必要了，谁也用不上”，too necessary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
necessary 意为“必然”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩必然的结果”，此处作前置定语 a necessary result of the change。
necessary 意为“必然”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩变革的必然结果一样必然”，同级比较用 as necessary as。
necessary 意为“必然”，家书上那半行字要的是“必然的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something necessary。
necessary 意为“必然”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当必然”，quite 修饰原级 necessary。
necessary 意为“必然”，no less necessary than 表示“其必然不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之必然不亚于任何人的预料。
necessary 意为“必然”，母亲 1983 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的必然结果”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件必要的家什。（a necessary tool for the job）
它必要到老屋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so necessary that …）
母亲觉得它太必要，谁也用不上。（too necessary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩必然的结果。（a necessary result of the change）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩变革的必然结果一样必然。（as necessary as …）
到了 1978 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件必然的东西。（something necessary）
answers: In 1971 the father wrote of a necessary tool for the job in the letter.
It was so necessary that nobody in the house would go near it.
My mother thought it too necessary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a necessary result of the change.
He said nobody would call it as necessary as the result of the change they had once had.
By 1978 the letter asked for nothing but something necessary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 necessary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the father wrote of a necessary tool for the job in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the necessary tool for the job that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too necessary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a necessary result of the change, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite necessary, and everybody laughed.
The necessary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
